title: Donut semicircle summary with delta overlaps the arc

complexity.rationale: The fix uses one new summary-layout signal to coordinate the existing arc, empty-state, and summary encodings, with focused unit and runtime geometry coverage.

summary: A DonutSummary with a delta line can extend into the inner edge of an S2 semicircle donut. The complete summary stack should remain contained within the semicircle hole without overlapping the arc.
symptom: When a semicircle Donut renders a summary value, label, and delta line, the value extends upward into the donut arc. Summary content that fits correctly without the delta can overlap once the third row is added.
rootCause: packages/vega-spec-builder-s2/src/donut/donutSummaryUtils.ts bottom-aligned the complete value/label/delta stack above the semicircle's flat diameter line. Adding the third delta row therefore pushed the value upward into the curved inner arc. packages/vega-spec-builder-s2/src/donut/donutUtils.ts anchored the semicircle center at the chart's bottom edge, leaving no canvas space for the delta to render below the diameter instead.

comparison.aspect: Summary containment inside the donut hole
comparison.expected: The value and label remain inside the semicircle while the delta renders below its flat diameter line without clipping.
comparison.actual: The complete three-line stack is forced above the diameter, pushing the value into the curved inner arc.

comparison.expected: Circle summaries remain centered, while semicircles reserve the delta row below the diameter when one is present.
comparison.actual: The semicircle remained anchored at the chart bottom and provided no space below its diameter for the delta.

edgeCases.case: Value, label, and positive or negative delta are visible
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: All three rows remain inside the semicircle hole with the intended row spacing.

edgeCases.case: Value and delta are visible without a label
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The two-row stack remains contained and uses the existing value-to-delta spacing.

edgeCases.case: The value is hidden while label and delta remain visible
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The label and delta remain contained without reserving space for the hidden value.

edgeCases.case: XS and other constrained semicircle sizes
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The existing minimum-inner-radius rule hides summary typography when the stack cannot fit.

edgeCases.case: Circle donut summary with a delta
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Existing centered circle-summary placement remains unchanged.

crossCutting.notes: A summary-bottom-offset signal coordinates the semicircle arc center with the summary stack only when value, label, and delta are all visible. It is a derived layout signal with no interaction set/clear path. S1 does not support the semicircle Donut variant, so there is no equivalent layout path to update.

implementationPlan.change: When value, label, and delta are all visible, calculate the delta row's below-diameter height, expose it as a summary-bottom-offset signal, and anchor the remaining summary rows above the semicircle diameter.
Cover the bottom-offset signal and the split value/label-above, delta-below semicircle summary layout.
Move semicircle arc and empty-state centers upward by the derived summary bottom offset when a delta has summary content above it.
Verify normal semicircles remain bottom-anchored and delta summaries reserve matching space for both data and empty-state arcs.
